narrative: On the part. Navarre's part on a bench in the tiring-parlour, the first line clear, a paper crown and a length of old velvet beside it. On the part. The same line. No new word in the margin. The rest of the part is out of the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the first line, left it, and kept the paper crown beside the part.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on part in Let Fame
